info.title: Geoapify Address Autocomplete API
info.description: Autocomplete partial addresses while a user types.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

get.description:
Returns address and place suggestions for partial text.

- `text` is required and may contain a partial address or place name.
- `filter` restricts results; `bias` influences ranking without excluding matches.
- Use `limit` to control the number of returned suggestions.

**Example:** `text=Orle`

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Partial address or place name to autocomplete.
